overall: The AG found one violation: the October 18 executive session notice failed to indicate an open session the public could attend. The other procedural, public-participation and executive-session-purpose complaints were rejected, and the records-request complaint was declined as outside the OML.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee did not follow proper procedures for convening in executive session on October 18.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Committee completed the appropriate procedural steps before convening in executive session, including announcing the purposes for the executive session and taking a roll call vote.

allegations.summary: The October 18 executive session notice did not list an open session, so the public was not told an open session would precede the executive session.
allegations.key_passage: By failing to indicate that the October 18 executive session meeting would include an open session that the public could attend, the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the 'Meeting of the Whole' was not a true public hearing because public participation was limited.
allegations.key_passage: As it is within the chair's discretion to limit public participation during a meeting, the Committee did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide for opportunities for public participation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee discussed a school employee's employment status in open session instead of executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require public bodies to meet in executive session but rather, if a public body chooses to meet in executive session, it must do so only for one of the enumerated purposes.

allegations.summary: Second complaint alleged the committee failed to respond to requests for information about whether members discussed a named employee in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: Here, we find that the complainant simply requested general information and answers to questions and did not make a request for meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Not raised by complainants: the AG noted on its own review that the October 18 executive session may not have fit any Purpose 3 grievance or litigation basis.
allegations.key_passage: Based on our in camera review of the October 18 meeting minutes, the Committee appears to have discussed neither a grievance matter nor litigation.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the law's requirements, and we caution that similar future violations could be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
